prompt: Execute approved parser steps 1-3: update reader, callers, and tests in the isolated worktree; review after all three.

assertions.text: Groups the three approved steps as one bounded batch with one cumulative review at the batch boundary (no per-microstep parent review)
assertions.evidence: with_skill reply: 'approved, bounded steps... one batch, review after all three' + 'review runs once... at the batch boundary — not after every microstep'; lifecycle run with per-step local gates named (EXECUTE runs ordered steps with own gates; REVIEW single cumulative). old_skill: no batch grouping — reply keeps its per-role lifecycle but review cadence is unspecified for a multi-step group (no 'one cumulative review at the batch boundary' concept).
